body:
Alright, I made some changes to the PR (refer to next steps comment to see them). 

I modify a little bit the storybook to show you what can be done (like modifying props live). I also tried to use snapshots, that works, but we have issues when snapshoting components from the public api: some are null. I Didn't take the time to investigate yet.
If you like what's already there, I will add all the widgets. 

Also, I didn't do the build part, because I think we need to discuss a little bit about it before. 

I modify the styling docs, it's not satisfying yet though. I think it would be better with a complete example and with us providing some utility functions to help perform merge/override of styles. 

Finally about the tests warnings. I believe it happens because now default theme are css files, and mocked with jest. So do we ignore them or maybe we can put the **DOC** variable to true when testing ? Any ideas ?
